name: Pouch of Magic Stones
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot —; Price 1,200 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This leather pouch holds up to ten stones or sling bullets.

The first ten stones or bullets retrieved from the pouch each day are imbued with the effect of a magic stone spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells magic stone; Cost 600 gp
